answer.justification: This presentation suggests reactive arthritis: recent bloody diarrhea followed by arthritis of lower-extremity joints, urethritis, and conjunctival injection. Reactive arthritis is associated with enthesitis, such as tenderness at the Achilles tendon insertion. The other findings are less consistent: erythema migrans suggests Lyme disease, finger extension pain suggests a different inflammatory arthropathy, and an RLQ mass suggests a gastrointestinal mass rather than reactive arthritis.
